result.markdown:
For a small team, I'd recommend **1Password Business** as the best all-round password manager, particularly if you want secure password sharing, easy onboarding, and straightforward administration without creating lots of IT overhead.

However, there are a few strong alternatives depending on your budget and how much control you need.

## Best password managers for small teams

![Wachtwoordmanager 1Password | KPN](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SR9cQiLQIFEFCALVJ5nUtWe25Q29qJVc5LjX65WdCnj5yzmD0dY1kGYKRcHN2028gLjEDLJ1Kkz4elZpmKF_3nFRDEJ56EPcrV1LwREU1riSDOE2qPsulZBrm1uLMFbZk3uGppXxaiJ5LZXh3ClEqc5wBJ1jJuMVahqzv5wwpeyD20eaUwi0i3WuDMRbtYuK?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password — Best overall**

(My recommendation)

- Excellent, intuitive interface.
- Shared vaults for company accounts.
- Granular permissions for different employees.
- Strong admin controls and security reporting.
- Good for non-technical teams.

**Best if\:** You want something the whole team will actually enjoy using.

Teams Starter Pack: approximately \$24.95/month for up to 10 users. Business: \$8.99/user/month, billed annually.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

**2\. Bitwarden — Best value**

- Open-source software.
- Secure shared collections.
- Admin controls and audit logs.
- Good cross-platform support.
- Self-hosting options on eligible plans.

**Best if\:** You want excellent security without spending much.

Teams: approximately \$4/user/month, billed annually.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper — Best for administration**

- Shared folders and team permissions.
- Delegated administration.
- Strong security and compliance features.
- Additional security products available.

**Best if\:** You have more formal security or compliance requirements.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Proton Pass Plus - Gestionnaire de mots de passe - Que Choisir Ensemble](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ieWxaf1V1oKwR5RRYZyCUPTssuPFmf3KGImAFxDImLo918b9HrqSkmcFxYOmTtZlPSYlBfMDN2fRfrT9cxgSPcskegAU9CMbarL_OHz9CIE3qqDdr6RF19eJVNxO2Ol4ntEKr3D7ZAQzGf8y8YfFA_bGj9p5D2RwqWU6uGCUEvGwoAX0vUa7O4BZUHkNpExF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass — Best privacy-focused alternative**

- Strong end-to-end encryption.
- Secure sharing.
- Privacy-focused provider based in Switzerland.
- Particularly interesting for European businesses.

**Best if\:** Privacy and data protection are major priorities.

[Proton Pass business plans](https://proton.me/business/pass)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to these two\:

| Your priority | Choose |
|--------|--------|
| Easiest for everyone to use | 1Password |
| Best security-to-price ratio | Bitwarden |
| More advanced administration | Keeper |
| Privacy-focused approach | Proton Pass |


For most small businesses, I would choose **1Password or Bitwarden** rather than overcomplicate things.

search_results.description: TechRadar’s 2025 guide reviews the best business password managers, emphasizing stronger security, privacy, credential sharing, employee productivity, and compliance. NordPass is recommended as the best overall choice because it combines affordability, ease of use, biometric and multifactor authentication, password sharing, and zero-knowledge XChaCha20 encryption; however, SSO and directory provisioning require its Enterprise plan. Dashlane is praised for general business use and polished administration, while RoboForm stands out for administrators through role-based permissions, provisioning, SSO, and policy controls. Keeper offers strong scalability, auditing, and support, though several integrations and monitoring tools cost extra. ManageEngine Password Manager Pro is a powerful self-hosted option for large enterprises, whereas Bitwarden appeals to organizations seeking open-source transparency. LogMeOnce suits SMBs, Proton Pass prioritizes privacy and data control, 1Password provides granular vault and guest access, and Sticky Password is an affordable choice for small teams. Buyers should assess company size, encryption, MFA, SSO, integrations, support, pricing, and compliance needs. Password managers also identify weak or reused credentials, reduce phishing risk, and improve productivity through autofill and passkeys.
